description: This file defines an abstract class 'FileTable' for Spark SQL data sources V2, handling file-based data reading and writing, schema inference, and capabilities within Spark's data source framework.

classes.name: FileTable
classes.description: An abstract class for file-based data sources in Spark SQL, supporting reading, writing, schema inference, and capabilities.

methods.name: inferSchema
methods.description: Abstract method to infer schema from files; should return None if unsupported.

methods.name: supportsDataType
methods.description: Checks if a data type is supported; defaults to true for all types.

methods.name: formatName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for the data source format.

methods.name: fallbackFileFormat
methods.description: Returns a fallback V1 FileFormat class if needed.

methods.name: mergedOptions
methods.description: Merges table options with operation options, respecting keys.

methods.name: mergedWriteInfo
methods.description: Merges table options with LogicalWriteInfo, respecting existing keys.
